notes: Inspected the complete body: it performs status checks, conditionally looks up and bounds-checks a value, then stores the derived byte at input+0x5b1 and calls a helper. The stored byte's semantic meaning is not recoverable from this body. No indexed caller is available, so keeping this sampled blank unnamed is appropriate.

Confirmed: the body converts the 32-bit integer argument to single precision, divides by 100.0f, and returns the float. An observed caller passes an attribute byte and consumes the resulting float into its output path. The proposal accurately names the operation.

Confirmed: the body checks two global record lookups in sequence and only then invokes the reconciliation/helper routine with the selected record data and the low bit of the third argument; failed lookups skip the call. A caller in initialize_contextual_record passes two context values and a zero flag. This supports guarded reconciliation of contextual records.

Confirmed: for a nonnull input record the function obtains a value through helpers and returns tiers 0 through 5 at thresholds 49, 59, 69, 79, and 89; null input returns -2. A caller stores/uses the result in a player-attribute workspace path. The proposed bucket/tier name is supported.

Confirmed: the function reads the record pointer, follows the nonnull path or initializes/resolves the default singleton on the null path, then tail-calls the record-value helper with field index zero. Its caller compares the returned value, and the same semantic name is already accepted for a related routine. The proposal describes the behavior accurately.
